[[File:SE-L-sfoils.gif|thumb|right|260px|[[S-foils]].]]
'''Guy Kargl''' won Decipher's 1997 Design a Card contest. His design became the [[Special Edition]] Effect [[S-foils]]. He was a 28-year-old hardware and software design engineer and a sanctioned tournament director from Tulsa, Oklahoma. He had played the [[Star Wars CCG]] since its November 1995 launch.<ref name="win">[http://www.decipher.com/insidedecipher/archives/1997/designawinner.html Guy Kargl Wins Star Wars CCG Card Design Contest], Rich Loftus, Decipher (23 May 1997). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990210055006/http://www.decipher.com/insidedecipher/archives/1997/designawinner.html Internet Archive]</ref> He was Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]] Red 61 FL from Tulsa. His slot was marked Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.<ref name="smlist" /> He was a call-in guest on [[Radio Free Decipher]] broadcast 9 (26 February 1999) with Chris Swearingen, [[Alex Alcalde]] and [[Carl Mike Hardy|Mike Hardy]].<ref name="rfd-09">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QU24jFxZsHM Radio Free Decipher 09], Player's Council (26 February 1999). Guests Chris Swearingen, [[Alex Alcalde]], Mike Hardy, and [[Guy Kargl]]. Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/youtube-QU24jFxZsHM Internet Archive].</ref>
